metadata.description: Azure Activity Log, Key Vault / AKS audit and (optional) Entra ID logs of the lab subscription.

azlogs.activity_deletes.name: [dev] Azure Activity Log: successful deletes in protected resource groups

azlogs.aks_exec.name: [dev] AKS exec / port-forward / attach into a pod

azlogs.diagnostic_settings_deleted.name: [dev] Azure diagnostic setting deleted (log export disabled)

azlogs.keyvault_access_denied.name: [dev] Key Vault access denied (401/403) above 10 in 15m

azlogs.logs_missing.name: [dev] No Azure platform logs received in 2h

azlogs.policy_deny_spike.name: [dev] Azure Policy denies above 20 in 1h

azlogs.rbac_changes.name: [dev] Azure RBAC role assignment created or deleted
azlogs.rbac_changes.query: logs("source:azure* -azure_log_type:application env:dev azure_log_type:activity @category:Administrative @resultType:Success @operationName:(MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION\/ROLEASSIGNMENTS\/WRITE OR MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION\/ROLEASSIGNMENTS\/DELETE OR Microsoft.Authorization\/roleAssignments\/write OR Microsoft.Authorization\/roleAssignments\/delete)").index("*").rollup("count").by("subscription_id").last("15m") > 0

azlogs.service_health.name: [dev] Azure Service Health incident for a region in use
azlogs.service_health.query: logs("source:azure* -azure_log_type:application env:dev azure_log_type:activity @category:ServiceHealth @properties.incidentType:(Incident OR ActionRequired OR Security) (@properties.region:Sweden\ Central OR @properties.region:Global)").index("*").rollup("count").by("@properties.trackingId").last("30m") > 0
